technical.summary: Mixed bullish signals in momentum and volume with concerning trend weakness (ADX 15), price below key moving averages (50/200), and Ichimoku cloud resistance; moderate confluence insufficient for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: ON shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 80 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 12) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (415.5), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and recent CPI miss create severely unfavourable macro conditions despite distant earnings event.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip, CMF cross-up, force index cross-up, and supertrend bullish create genuine momentum confluence with price near support (51.46), offering contrarian opportunity in extreme fear environment.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA with weak ADX (15), Ichimoku cloud resistance overhead, stochastic momentum at 36.76, negative Awesome Oscillator, zero fundamental conviction, and macro crisis conditions (VIX 415.5, rising dollar, flat yield curve) make this a low-probability entry despite technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum signals (hull flip, CMF cross, force index) show genuine bullish confluence at support, and extreme fear environment presents contrarian opportunity. decision.primary_risk: Macro crisis conditions (VIX 415.5, rising dollar, flat yield curve) combined with price below key moving averages and Ichimoku cloud resistance create high probability of breakdown below support (51.46) despite short-term momentum signals.
